title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test workflows and standardize release automation
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Our CI workflows have drifted across repositories (multiple node versions, duplicated lint/test steps, and multiple ad-hoc release jobs). This PR consolidates lint and test pipelines into a shared .github/workflows matrix, standardizes NodeJS/runtime versions, and centralizes release automation into a single maintainable workflow and helper scripts. The goals are: reduce duplicated CI config, speed up CI by sharing caching strategies, make release automation deterministic, and improve repo hygiene (remove legacy scripts). Changes in this PR: - Introduce .github/workflows/ci.yml that consolidates lint, unit, and integration test stages into a single reusable workflow with a matrix for node versions and platform-specific steps. - Add .github/workflows/release.yml: canonicalized release pipeline that uses the new release helper script and validates changelog/release-notes before publishing. - Add tools/ci-bootstrap.sh and tools/ci-lint.sh to keep platform-agnostic steps in scripts rather than inline YAML. - Replace multiple repository-level Node version pins with .nvmrc and a single actions/setup-node usage. - Consolidate ESLint/Prettier configs under redwood/.eslintrc.json and redwood/.prettierrc and update npm scripts for consistent lint/test commands. - Move release notes validation into tools/release-notes-validator and add a lightweight action wrapper under .github/actions/validate-release/action.yml. - Cleanup: remove legacy scripts/scripts/legacy-ci-helpers.sh and update README CI docs (docs/ci.md) with the new workflow overview and migration notes. Compatibility & migration: Most repositories will continue to run unchanged; maintainers should remove local CI files that duplicate the centralized workflows. The new release workflow requires maintainers to add a RELEASE_LABEL to protected branches for gated releases; documentation updated in docs/ci.md. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate lint/test steps into single workflow - [x] Add release automation and validation - [x] Add shared scripts and action wrapper - [x] Update docs and README - [x] Run across core monorepo packages and fix failing tests (addressed in follow-ups) Related: ENG-4123, OPS-987, SUP-234
commits: feat(ci): add consolidated ci.yml and release.yml; chore(ci): add ci-bootstrap and lint helper scripts; refactor: centralize eslint/prettier configs; test: update test scripts to use shared commands; fix(ci): address caching and matrix failures after initial run
review_comments: Liam Chen (reviewer): Small nit: can we reduce the matrix to only node14/node18 for now? running all 4 versions adds too much time. Also suggest using actions/cache keyed by node-modules-path + lockfile.
Asha Patel (author): Updated the matrix to node14/node18 and wired cache key to package-lock.json + path. Left note in ci.md about expanding matrix later.
Sofia Martinez (reviewer): Release job looks good. Please add an explicit changelog validation step and make the release job require passing lint/test jobs before deploy.
Asha Patel (author): Added release-notes-validator and made release job depend on ci-job success. Also added a retry for transient publish errors.
Rajiv Kannan (approver): Verified on a fork and smoke-tested a dry-run release. Approving pending green CI.
CI: initial run failed on flaky integration test (timeout). Re-ran pipeline after bumping timeout in ci.yml; subsequent run passed.
Liam Chen (maintainer): LGTM, approving and will follow up on removing per-package CI files across the repo after merge.
release_notes: Consolidate CI and release pipelines: centralizes lint/test workflows, standardizes Node versions, adds canonical release automation and release-notes validation, and removes legacy CI scripts. Improve caching and reduce CI duplication across the monorepo.
